title: Mom Loses It After Her Son Is Murdered at a Gas Station
description:
#police #news #crime

On May 30th, 2025. A 23-year-old man was arrested a month and a half after allegedly shooting and killing his 17-year-old boyfriend at a Marion County truck stop. Deputies responded to a report of a shooting at a gas station, where the victim was found with a gunshot wound and later d*ed at the hospital. Investigators say the couple argued after the older man became upset about the victim messaging other men. During the confrontation, the suspect allegedly shot the victim, struck him, and fled the scene. He was later arrested and charged with second-degree murder, currently being held without bond. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
